items.html: (And what seems to me about this is that this knot is the surrounding light of the Mochin of Leah, and it is not Leah herself, and it is like the Tefillin of the hand, which is the surrounding light of the Mochin of Rachel. And this is necessary, to my poor opinion, and as I explained below concerning the Tefillin of the hand, that it comes out of the striking of the lock of the hairs of the Ibur of ZA, which are the four Tzitzit. And likewise there are four Tzitzit of the strands of the Mochin of Yenika, striking the head of Leah, and they bring out in her the surrounding light of the Mochin in the secret of a knot, as stated in the discourse of the Tzitzit, concerning the strands of Yenika drawn to the head of Leah. From Rav Chaim Vital, of blessed memory.)
